errors.profile_import.no_text: Couldn't read text from that file — try a DOCX, or paste the text instead.
errors.profile_import.unsupported: That file type isn't supported here. Use a PDF, DOCX, LinkedIn export ZIP or plain text.
errors.profile_import.read: That file couldn't be read. Check that it still exists and try again.
errors.profile_import.too_large: That import is too large. Use a shorter CV, or paste the text.
errors.profile_import.store: Your profile could not be read or saved.
errors.profile_import.contract: The agent sent facts Boba couldn't read. Run the import again.
errors.profile_import.unknown_proposal: That suggestion is no longer waiting for review.
errors.profile_import.run: The import didn't finish. The AI engine may be signed out or out of quota.
errors.profile_import.no_engine: Choose an AI engine in the previous step before importing your CV.
errors.profile_import.nothing: Pick a CV file or paste your CV text first.
errors.profile_import.stale: That suggestion was made before your last edit. Ask for a fresh one and review it again.
